verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a broad public API with write coverage across many core objects: custom and library controls, document mappings, contracts, document and policy uploads, bulk owner assignment, offboarding, audits and information requests, and Trust questionnaire responses. Its MCP server also exposes that API to AI assistants. However, no evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and several major UI products have no documented endpoints. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage for Trust Center, Access Reviews, risk register, TPRM/vendor management and AI Agent workflows, and independent corroboration that UI actions are all reachable via API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
